Languages, frameworks, data, tests, browser, infra and evidence references come from Core records, with unknowns explicit.

No horizontal overflow; portfolio stacks above detail and controls remain usable.
Portfolio buttons, refresh and triage remain reachable; labels and live regions are present.

limitations: This is implementer evidence, not independent acceptance.
Only the Director projection slice is implemented; Operation Manager runtime, concurrency, repair, spec issue publishing, Explorer/Librarian/Context7, skills and dynamic fleets remain pending.
Semantic triage requires an active request-scoped subscription admission; historical requests with consumed funding cannot be re-assessed.
The StackProfile is advisory and may contain low-confidence model inference; Explorer confirmation is not implemented.
No isolation or security certification is claimed. TRUSTED_LOCAL is broad local access.
